title: Scope make pr-check pytest and start agents on the stack tip
objective: Cut make pr wall-clock by (1) running only the tests that cover changed Python on make pr-check, and (2) creating agent worktrees from the unambiguous open-PR stack tip when PR_STACK=auto, so the gate diffs a small delta instead of origin/main and never restacks after a four-minute suite.
success_criteria: Given one open PR chain and default PR_STACK=auto, agent_worktree_start.sh records base_ref as that tip head and base_sha as the fetched tip SHA, not origin/main
Given two sibling open PRs both targeting main, worktree start exits nonzero and names both heads; it does not pick one
Given PR_STACK= (empty), worktree start still uses origin/main with no extra authorization flag

Given a changed-file list of only ops/autonomy/merge_gate.py and tests/ops/autonomy/test_merge_gate.py, make pr-check pytest argv does not include environment/program-execution or environment/agents/generated-data suites and does include those two paths (or the inferred test file)
make test, make pr-full, and CI profile argv still collect the full python-contract catalog including repo-root '.'
make pr-check PASS on the implementation branch

in: New shared stack-tip resolver used by agent_worktree_start.sh and open_pr_after_gate.sh
ops/scripts/pr_overlap_check.py auto-stack when a unique chain exists even without file overlap
Tests under tests/ops/scripts/ and docs: AGENTS.md, surface_profile.yaml, rules/53-pr-overlap-guardrail.mdc
Optional same-gate ruff-format restage so a style-only follow-up does not replay the catalog
out: Weakening ruff, gitleaks, bandit, semgrep, or CI coverage
Changing merge_gate stack-parent squash denial or stack_safe_merge.py method selection
Rebasing or rewriting published PR history
Direct git push to Cursor-Governance main

stress_test.blast_radius: Under-scoped pytest can merge a helper break. Auto-start on the wrong sibling can recreate the squash-parent orphan. A fail-open gh outage can fork main while a stack exists.
stress_test.rollback: Revert the commit(s) on the feature branch. Restore run_pr_gate.sh pytest to run_pytest_suites.sh with only the secrets ignore. Restore agent_worktree_start.sh origin/main default. Keep stack_safe_merge.py and merge_gate parent-squash denial untouched.

risks.risk: Scoped pytest misses a regression in an unmapped helper
risks.mitigation: No inferred test plus no non-dot owning suite fails closed to that directory's tests/ or blocks the gate; CI/pr-full stay full-catalog

risks.risk: Starting on the wrong open PR orphans a sibling after squash
risks.mitigation: Sibling chains exit 2 at start; only a unique chain tip is used

risks.risk: Authorization leak: any non-main --base becomes auto-approved
risks.mitigation: Implied authorization applies only when the resolver selected the tip and the agent did not pass a conflicting --base

unknowns.question: When gh cannot list open PRs at start, is the required behavior fail-closed (no worktree) or origin/main with a printed WARN?
unknowns.decision_effect: Fail-closed blocks all new tasks offline; WARN+main recreates the late-restack cost when the network returns
